params.text: An Adventure Through Tanzania's Serengeti

Get ready for a safari!
Meet four Serengeti animals and discover how each one survives in this environment.

params.alt: Wide view of the Serengeti landscape in Tanzania, showing open grassland, a tree, elephants, and zebras.
Map of Tanzania with Serengeti National Park circled in northern Tanzania.

params.text:
The Serengeti is a huge grassland in East Africa.

Our safari takes place in Tanzania, where animals like giraffes, zebras, elephants, and lions share this habitat.               

🌾 They all live in the same place—but they don't all survive in the same way!
📍 This is where our safari takes place!

params.audioNotSupported: Your browser does not support this audio

params.text:
👀 As you explore the Serengeti, look for clues that show how each animal survives.
 

🐾 An adaptation is a body part or behavior that helps a living thing survive in its habitat.

By the end of your safari, you will be able to:

🔎 Identify how an animal's adaptation helps it survive in the Serengeti.

params.text:
👀 Look closely!
Giraffes eat leaves from trees. Look at the photos. What body feature might help a giraffe reach food high above the ground?

choices.question:
🔎 Choose your answer:
Which adaptation helps a giraffe reach leaves high in trees?

overallFeedback.feedback: 🔎 Look again! Study the photos and think about which body part helps the giraffe reach leaves high in a tree. Try again!
⭐ Great observation! A giraffe’s long neck helps it reach leaves high in trees that many other animals cannot reach.

params.alt: A large herd of zebras gathered together in the grasslands of Serengeti National Park.

params.text:
👀 Look closely!
These zebras are traveling together in a herd—a group of animals that live or move together. What do you notice about how they stay together?

dialogs.text: How could living in a herd help a zebra stay safe?
dialogs.answer:
🐾 Safety in Numbers!
Look at how many zebras are in this herd! Living in a large group means more zebras can watch and listen for predators. If one zebra notices danger, the herd can react and move together.

params.text: Life in the Serengeti can be challenging—even for a powerful lion! Lions need to find food, protect their young, and stay safe in their environment.

🔎 Look Closely
What do you notice about these lions? Why might living together help them survive?

params.alt: Group of lions resting together in the grasslands of Serengeti National Park, Tanzania.

params.text: 🐾 Discover the Lion's Survival Secret! →

params.audioNotSupported: Your browser does not support this audio

params.text:
🦁 SURVIVAL SECRET! 

Lions live in groups called prides. Lions in a pride can work together to hunt for food and protect their territory.
